title: HomeFlood Installment Amount After the First Payment
content:
**Calculation.** An installment after the first on a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy is the later-installment share of the term premium item booked for the installment's term, plus the tier's installment fee. It is rounded to the cent once, at the end, and is never below zero.

| Plan | Later-installment share of the booked term premium item |
|---|---|
| QUARTERLY | 20 percent |
| semi-annual | 50 percent |

**The installment's term.** The installment's term is the term of the latest first payment (installment 1) received on the policy. Where several such payments share the latest date, the one recorded first counts.

**Rounding.** Rounding to the cent takes the nearest cent; an amount lying exactly halfway between two cents goes to the even cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- A QUARTERLY policy whose booked term premium item is 1,850.00 has a later-installment share of 20 percent, that is 370.00. Adding the installment fee of 6 gives an installment of 376.00.
- A semi-annual policy with a booked term premium item of 963.30 has a later-installment share of 481.65. Adding 6 gives 487.65.
